engine.implementation: pqctoday-hsm softhsmrustv3 (Rust), native macOS cdylib libsofthsmrustv3.dylib
engine.sourceCommitEvidence: Built from a clean detached worktree created for this run (git -C pqctoday-hsm worktree add --detach pqctoday-hsm-mac-417c47a2 417c47a2…; no submodules needed). `git status --porcelain` was empty before and after; the worktree was removed afterwards. Same commit the Rust WASM bundle is anchored to (wasm-provenance.json softhsmrustv3-engine._reanchor20260923: byte-identical rebuild).

build.compiler: rustc 1.96.0 (ac68faa20 2026-05-25), host aarch64-apple-darwin, LLVM 22.1.2 — rustup toolchain 1.96.0-aarch64-apple-darwin invoked by absolute path (~/.cargo/bin not on PATH); C build-deps (aws-lc-sys and others) compiled by Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), Xcode 27.0 (27A266a), macOS SDK 27.0
build.features: default (no acvp, no hw-accel) — the shipped native feature set; the WASM bundle additionally enables acvp (C_Initialize pReserved RNG-seeding hook, unused: both runners pass NULL)
build.location: macOS host (Apple M5 Max, macOS 26.6.2 build 25G83), native arm64 with the host Rust toolchain + Xcode — permitted for the macOS row only (acvp-gap-closure plan §P4); CARGO_TARGET_DIR in the session scratchpad, removed after the runs

entropy.source: getrandom crate (0.2.17 / 0.4.2 in rust/Cargo.lock) → macOS system entropy

notes: aws-lc-rs (aws-lc-sys) is statically linked for the RSA / NIST-curve ECDH fast path only (rust/src/crypto/awslc.rs); ML-KEM decapsulation and ML-DSA verification run on the pure-Rust crates. The dylib links no libcrypto (otool -L: libiconv, libSystem only).
hw-accel feature OFF: no FPGA/NPU offload path is compiled in.
Crates: the first build fetched with --locked from crates.io into the host ~/.cargo registry (the host cache lacked rustls 0.23.45); the rebuild ran --offline.

Reproducibility: the Mach-O install name embeds the absolute CARGO_TARGET_DIR path, so a rebuild is only comparable at the same path. The target dir was deleted and rebuilt from scratch at the same path; the SHA-256 was identical (0eef6de33a3d0fe3eb48a940a3f9b476fb60622ac0a37f4fe452297aaa251fe3).
